audit_streams.common_full_support: one additional frozen full-support batch set reused for both models in a seed and across all checkpoints
audit_streams.support_specific: independent frozen full-support batches for G1 and frozen training-support batches for G2

initialization_reconstruction: torch, NumPy, and Python seeds are reset to the registered model seed before constructing the unchanged parent-exposed Transformer

metric_definitions.mean_pairwise_gradient_cosine: mean over all unordered pairs of per-batch unit gradient vectors
metric_definitions.paired_difference: G2 metric minus paired G1 metric
